meta.description: Ad, page, follow-up, booking. A done-for-you client acquisition system, built, connected and launched for you at one fixed price, live in days.

hero.title: The Sansara Client Loop: an ad in, a booked client out.
hero.lead: Ad, page, follow-up, booking. Four pieces, built and connected for you at one fixed price, live in days, so the right people find your work and book without you chasing anyone.

pains.title: Sound familiar?
items: They ask what I charge… and then just vanish.
Loads of likes. Nobody actually books.
I always mean to follow up. Then the week's just gone.
I never know where the next one's coming from.

leaks.title: You don't need more attention. You need what happens after it to work.
leaks.lead: Your offer works. Your clients tell you so. The gap is everything between someone noticing you and someone actually booking. That's where clients leak out, quietly, every week.
items: People find you, but nothing makes them want to book.
Someone shows interest, then waits, because no one replies in time.
They're ready to book, but there's no clear next step.
The curious ones drift off, and never come back.
leaks.punch: None of this means you're bad at what you do. It means the bit between “interested” and “booked” was never actually built.

stages.title: Four steps, one connected system, built around your offer.
stages.lead: We take the offer you already have and wire the four steps around it. Each one closes one of the leaks above.

items.title: Ad
items.text: Your offer in front of the people already looking for what you do.
deliverables: One ad campaign, set up for you
Words that speak to your ideal client

items.title: Page
items.text: One clear page where booking with you is the obvious next step.

items.title: Follow-up
items.text: Every enquiry gets a warm, instant reply, even while you're with a client. No one waits, no one is forgotten.
deliverables: A list of interested people that belongs to you

items.title: Booking
items.text: Interest becomes a booked session, a reserved spot or a sale, straight into your calendar.
deliverables: Booking in a couple of taps
Simple tracking: which ad works, what a booking costs

why.title: Not an agency retainer. Not software. A small studio that builds the whole thing and hands you the keys.
why.lead: No proposal deck, no three-month wait, no dashboard you have to learn. We build, connect and launch the system, then show you what's working. You keep doing the work you love.

values.title: Done for you
values.text: We build, connect and launch it. You never touch the tech.

values.title: Fixed and fast
values.text: One price, live in days. No surprises.

values.title: Yours to keep
values.text: Ad account, page, list and data are set up in your name from day one.

fit.title: We only take it on when it fits.
fit.lead: We'd rather say no now than take your money for something that won't work.
for: You coach, consult, treat or run a business where clients book you directly.
You have one offer that already works. Clients come back and recommend you.
You know roughly what a client is worth to you, so an ad budget makes sense.
You'd rather have it built than learn to build it.
not: You're still figuring out what you offer or who it's for.
You want to run five offers at once. We build around one.
You expect a system to work with no ad budget at all.
You want someone to run your social media or make content. That's not what we build.

process.title: Live in four steps.
process.lead: Your part is one call, one round of feedback and a short handover. The rest is ours.

steps.title: Call: get clear on your offer
steps.text: We agree on the one thing you're offering and the one step you want people to take.

steps.title: Build: page, words and ads
steps.text: We create your page, your copy and your ads, all around that one offer.

steps.title: Connect: follow-up and booking
steps.text: Replies, reminders and your booking or checkout, wired together and tested.

steps.title: Launch: go live and improve
steps.text: It goes live. We watch what's working, and show you how to read it yourself.

price.title: One offer. One system. One fixed price.
price.lead: You get the exact figure on the free call, in writing, before you decide anything. It doesn't change afterwards.
points: One payment for the build. No retainer you can't leave.
Everything listed above is included. Nothing is billed by the hour.
Need a second offer, more places to advertise or a deeper setup? Those are added on the same system, at a fixed price too.
price.adBudget: The ad budget is separate. You pay it directly to the platform, in your own account. On the call we'll tell you what a sensible starting budget looks like for your offer. If there's no room for one right now, this isn't the moment, and we'll say so.

faqTitle: The doubts we hear on almost every call.

final.title: Find out if the Loop fits your business.
final.text: One free call. We look at how people find you now, where they drop out, and whether this is the right fix. If it isn't, we'll tell you what is.
